parties: <cite index="1-1">Motilal Oswal Group investing in Inox Clean Energy, the integrated renewable energy platform of the INOXGFL Group</cite>
headline: <cite index="1-1">Motilal Oswal Group commits ₹1,500 crore investment in Inox Clean Energy via compulsorily convertible debentures; ₹1,000 crore already deployed</cite>
sum: Motilal Oswal Group commits ₹1,500 crore ($157 million) to Inox Clean Energy through CCDs. Funds will support growth, particularly inorganic growth initiatives.
implication: <cite index="48-4">CCDs structured as hybrid capital combining downside debt protection with equity-linked upside, with conversion into equity upon IPO access</cite>-a precedent structuring for pre-IPO stage renewable energy platforms.
detail: <cite index="1-1">₹1,000 crore of the ₹1,500 crore commitment has already been completed</cite>. <cite index="1-4">Funds raised in form of Compulsorily Convertible Debentures (CCDs) will be utilised to support Inox Clean's growth, particularly its inorganic growth initiatives</cite>. <cite index="38-6,38-7">Over the past 18 months, Inox Clean has scaled through acquisitions including US-based Boviet Solar and renewable energy platforms backed by global investors including GIP's Vena Energy, Macquarie's Vibrant Energy, SHV's SunSource Energy and CalPERS-backed SkyPower including its Africa business</cite>. <cite index="20-5">Inox Clean's renewable IPP portfolio in India stood at 3 GW at end of June 2026 and is expected to exceed 6 GW of operational capacity by end of FY27</cite>.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 - Sections 1–14, 180–181 (Board approval for raising debentures)
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Reg 30 (disclosure of material events)

Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Master Direction – Non-Banking Financial Company – Scale Based Regulation, 2023
framework.note: applies to Motilal Oswal Group as NBFC

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue and Listing of Non-Convertible and Redeemable Preference Shares) Regulations, 2013 - as adapted for CCDs
framework.note: ccds classify as hybrid securities; disclosure and listing rules apply if listed debentures

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961 - Sections 43, 48, 194LA (debenture interest withholding)
framework.note: tax withholding on CCD interest accrual

structure.consideration: ₹1,500 crore total commitment ($157 million); ₹1,000 crore already deployed via CCDs as of 13 August 2026
conditions: CCDs to convert into equity upon Inox Clean Energy accessing capital markets (IPO trigger)
Remaining ₹500 crore expected to be drawn in coming weeks as acquisition and capex plans progress
approvals: Inox Clean Energy board approval for CCD issuance
Motilal Oswal Group investment committee approval for deployment from India Credit Excellence Fund – I
CCI clearance likely (no formal merger/control change, but monitoring given portfolio concentration)
structure.novel: CCD structure with debt-like downside protection and equity upside linked to IPO exit; ties equity conversion to SEBI IPO approval rather than fixed valuation date-common in pre-IPO private credit in renewables sector.

triggers.law: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018; SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
triggers.note: IPO filing by Inox Clean Energy in July 2025 (draft DRHP) triggers conversion mechanics

triggers.law: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) Schedule 1 - if any investor (e.g. CalPERS) is deemed FPI
triggers.note: cross-border investor participation in CCDs may trigger FEMA reporting; Motilal Oswal is domestic

triggers.law: Companies Act, 2013 - Section 179, 180 (related party transaction rules if Motilal Oswal is deemed related to INOXGFL)
triggers.note: unlikely but flagged for confirmatory review
